label: KGhost
description: Race against a ghost on your Karoo: a fixed-pace Ghost Pace or your own past self on a route, stitched into one continuous ghost. Shows the live time/distance gap on graphical and numeric data fields and draws the ghost's position on the map. Records each ride automatically and can import GPX/FIT ghosts dropped in /sdcard/KGhost. Keeps estimating during GPS dropouts. Needs All files access: grant it in the KGhost app so it can find your past rides.
releaseNotes: KGhost now finds the rides already on your Karoo by itself (no Import button) and learns your pace on every gradient from your whole ride history, so on roads you have never ridden the ghost climbs and descends at your usual pace instead of freezing the gap. On a route you barely know it races your Ghost Pace target instead of sitting at 0, and the gap now survives a Karoo or ride-app restart and switching KGhost off and on mid-ride. Less background work: indoor rides and unchanged libraries are no longer reprocessed after every ride.
